tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ las thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po'o// dang po ni/ rgya shog dri ma med pa la rgya snag gis lte ba/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du pad 'dab brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu khro bo'i rdo rje/ steng du rtse gsum dang 'og tu rtse gsum ste kha drug tu gyes pa// de'i phyi rol tu mu khyud rim pa lnga/ de'i phyi rol tu me ris bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐/ de la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi zad par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad srung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po wa shaṃ ma na ya hoḥde'i phyi rol rtsibs brgyad la/ na maḥ tsaṇa ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab brgyad la/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ lte ba bzhin du bris pa'i 'dod gsol/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇaḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣase ṇa pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/

ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ steng gi rwa g.yas dbus g.yon gsum/ 'og gi g.yon dbus g.yas la/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇaḍa badz+ra bā ḍa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa nā pa ta ye/ 'dod gsol/ de'i phyi la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghur+ṇā ghur+ṇā// ghur+ṇā pa ya ghur+ṇā pa ya/ sarba sa twā ni/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bodha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bid+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya swā hā/ de'i phyi ma la/ he phul+lu ni ru phul+lu gṛh+ṇa kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ mahā ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha kro dha badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dhā rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra bra bhañja nā ya swā hā/ ma ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ shru ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ pra ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ de'i phyi la/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya swā hā/ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭ/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya/

ma hā ba le/ ka ṭa be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ de'i phyir/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣānatathā ga to h+ya wa data/ te shāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī mahā gra ma ṇā ya swā hā// zhes bris/ zhi rgyas dbang drag po'i rdzas/ phyogs shar lho nub byang ma 'chol bar gzhug go /zhi ba'i 'khor lo la gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bzhi rim dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+yathā/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ he phul+lu ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+ṇa kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya/ bdag gi sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sarba bi gh+nān/ sarba ro ga na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa/ sarba dz+wa ra/ sarba u pa dra wa/ sarba gra ha/ sarba a kā la mṛ ta/ sarba duraswap+nān/ sarba du mṛ te/ sarba ku sha le bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rtsibs la/ gnod par byed pa rnams/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ g.yas skor du gnyis pa la/ gnod par byed pa rnams/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gsum pa la gnod par byed pa rnams/ ghur+ṇā ghur+ṇā/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ bzhi ba la gnod par byed pa rnams/ sarba satwā ni/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ lnga pa la gnod par byed pa rnams/

bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ drug pa la gnod par byed pa rnams/ sarba bhu tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ bdun pa la gnod par byed pa rnams/ sarba sha trun/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ brgyad pa la gnod par byed pa rnams/ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ mu khyud dang po la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañja nā ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīgh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ ma ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ shru ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ pra ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ mthar/ sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru sogs gdags par bya'o// de'i phyir/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa sa nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te/ sarba pā paṃ sogs/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la ā li kā li/ de'i phyir mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po bri'o// gnyis pa bsrung ba ni/ lte ba mu khyud 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de'i phyi la mu khyud/ de'i phyir rtsibs bcu/ de'i phyir mu khyud bzhi rim du bya'o// dang po lte bar hūm̐/ mthar/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā na ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ 'chang ba la sarba pā paṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba bigh+nān rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba ro ga na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba dz+wa ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba u pa drā wa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba gra ha rak+ṣa/ sarba a kā la mṛ ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba duraswap+nān/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba dumṛ ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sarba ku sha le rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/

sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ṭa be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga la/ da ha da ha/ te dzo ba ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ rtsibs mdun nas g.yas bskor gyi dang po la/ oṃ badz+ra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnyis pa la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ bzhi pa la/ oṃ badz+ra hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsibs mchan la/ gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ mu khyud la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa ki li ki lā ya swāhā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañja nā ya swā hā/ 'dod gsol/ rtsibs bcu la/ oṃ badz+ra he ra he ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu na dhu na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra dha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra ya dhār ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bhin+da bhin+da hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsibs mchan sngar bzhin/ de nas phyi'i mu khyad la/ he phul+lu ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+ṇa kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha rā ya/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs tshang bar bri/ de'i phyi rol tu dbyangs gsal/ bzhi pa la ye dharmā bri'o// rgyas pa'i 'khor lo ni/ lte ba gru bzhi/ phyi rol mu khyud gru bzhi bzhi sbrag byas/

lte ba'i zur du mgo steng rin po che cha brgyad pa bzhi bri/ lte ba gru bzhir/ bai mtha' bskor du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pāṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra ā yu yarta ne puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ rin po che dang po la/ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa ku ru swā hā/ gnyis pa la/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya ku ru swā hā/ gsum pa la/ sarba bid+yā saṃbh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya ku ru swā hā/ bzhi pa la/ ba su dhā ra ṇi kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa ku ru swā hā/ phyi'i mu khyud la/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa ni la badz+ra su badz+ra ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīgh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ bcom ldan 'das nor gyi bdag po'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ de'i phyir/ na mo rat+na tra yā na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīghaṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku lamā wa rta ya/ 'dod don sngar bzhin/ de'i phyi la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pa ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra nas/ a mṛ te/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ dha ra dha ra nas/ 'dod gsol gyi bar bri'o// de'i phyir rten 'brel snying po/ dbang ngam dgug pa'i 'khor lo ni/ lte ba zla gam mu khyud kyang zla gam bzhi sbrag /zla gam gyi lte bar hūm̐/ g.yas g.yon du hrīḥmathar/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/

tad+ya thā/ sarba bi d+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīghaṃ badz+ra dha ra ya/ ki li ki lā ya/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya/ bdag gi che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ lha 'dre mi gsum dang khams gsum thams cad wa shaṃ ma nā ya ho/ phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā wa rta ya/ ma hā ba le/ ka ṭa be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye// a ti badz+ra/ mahā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga le/ 'dod gsol sngar bzhin/ de'i phyi la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ nas/ a mṛ te/ e h+ya hi badz+ra/ shīgh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ na maḥsaman+ta nas 'dod gsol gyi bar sdar bzhin no// de'i phyir lcags kyu la sogs pa bri'o// bsad pa'i 'khor lo ni// 'khor lo rtsibs drug rno ba mu khyud la ma reg ba/ lte ba la liṅga sngags byang dang bcas pa/ phyi rol mu khyud gsum rim pa bzhin/ rtsi bas mdun ma la/ sarba sha trunā nāṃ/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ g.yon du bskor ba'i rtsibs la/ sarba sha trūn saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya mā ra ya rbad/ gsum pa la/ sarba sha trunā mā ra ya mā ra ya rbad/ bzhi pa la/ sarba sha trun/ tru ṭa tru ṭa che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ lnga pa la/ sarba sha trun tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ drug pa la/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ sarba ba le dza a bar dza ye ma hā ba le che ge mā ra ya rbad/ phyi'i mu khyud la/ na mo ran+ta tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sarba bi d+ya badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+ra ya/

e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīgh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ de'i phyi la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ tsu ru tsu ru ki li ki lā ya/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ de'i phyi la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas/ a mṛ te/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shīgh+ra badz+ra dhā rā ya a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ de'i phyi la mtshon cha sna tshogs kha nang du bstan pa bri'o// mnan pa'i 'khor lo ni/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ mā ra ya'i tshab tu/ a mu kaṃ staṃ bha ya nan zhes bsgyur/ rgyab tu 'khor lo bzlog pa bzhin/ de gnyis ka la bzlog pa'i 'khor lor bshad pa bzhin gyi dmod mo yang bri'o// byad ma'i rang gshed rang la dbab pa sngags bzlog nag po'i tsakra ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug rno ba mu khyud la ma reg pa/ phyir mu khyud/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad/ de'i mthar mu khyud gru gsum pa nyis rim du byas pa'i lte bar/ gnod byed kyi byad ma yan lag brgyangs pa/ lce phyir phyogs pa'i rtse mo lte bar sleb pa/ dkyil du rdo rje rgya gram rwa bcu gnyis/ lte bar nri+-i'aṃ tri/ byang byed dam/ gnod byed 'byung po'i ming gi mthar/ mā ra ya khug dzaḥ.oṃ bhin+da bhin+da che ge mo bhin+da mahā ki li ki lā ya che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces bskor/ yan lag rtsibs drug gi nang du brgyangs pa la/ lag g.yas par hūṃ dzaḥ g.yon par ril thum/ rkang pa g.yas pa la rbad rbad/ g.yon par bh+yo dza dza/ gsang gnas la phaṭ laṃ/ spyi bor staṃ bha ya/ dpral bar rus/ brla la bla dgas/ lce'i steng rdo rje rwa'i bar du/ che ge mo'i rig sngags ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ mā ra ya phaṭ/ che ge mo'i ngag rengs par gyis shig /che ge mo rig sngags bhin+da bhin+da mā ra ya phaṭ/ che ge mo'i ngag rengs par gyis shig /che ge mo'i rig sngags staṃ bha ya nan/ staṃ bha ya nan/ mā ra ya phaṭ/ che ge mo'i ngag rengs par gyis shig

/che ge mo'i rig sngags ma tha ma tha mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces bri/ shar gyi rtsibs la/ sarba sha trunā gha ṭa gha ṭa che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ g.yon nas sarba sha trunā saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ gsum pa la/ sarba sha trunā mā ra ya mā ra ya che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ bzhi pa la/ sarba sha trūn ghur+ṇā ghur+ṇā che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ lnga pa la/ sarba sha trunā ghur+ṇā pa ya ghur+ṇā pa ya che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ drug pa la/ sarba sha trunā ma ṭa ma ṭa che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ phyi'i mu khyud la/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ sarba ba le/ a pa ra dza ye ma hā ba le che ge mo mā ra ya rbad byad ma che ge mo'i snying rtsal kha rag dun te rbad/ byad ma che ge mo'i srog la rbad/ che ge mo'i dbugs la rngubs/ che ge mo'i sha la choms/ che ge mo'i sha rus khrag rtsal nur nur zhes pa'i dmod pa bri/ shar gyi rtsibs la/ a ya mā du ru tsa sha na/ bo dha ya bo dha ya che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ g.yon nas gnyis pa la/ a ya mā du ru tsa sha na/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ gsum pa la/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ bzhi pa la/ che ge mo'i rig sngags thams cad ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ lnga pa la/ che ge mo'i rig sngags thams cad bhin+da bhin+da che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ drug pa la/ che ge mo'i rig sngags thams cad ban+dha ban+dha che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ bdun pa la/ che ge mo'i rig sngags thams cad ma tha ma tha che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ brgyad pa la/ che ge mo'i ngag gi nus mthu thams cad ha ra ha ra che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ de'i phyir gzungs mdo sde bzhin du bris pa'i mthar/ byad ma che ge mo'i rig sngags thams cad ces sogs/ de'i mthar/ gnod byed byad ma 'di la/ gnod byed lha bsrung gshed du phob cig /rang lha bdud du phob cig /lus rang gshed du phob cig /ngag rang gshed du phob cig

/yid rang gshed du phob cig /chos skyong*/ kho rang gi nus pa kho rang gi gshed du phob cig /rang srog rang gis chod cig /rang mtshon rang la tshugs shig kho rang gi lhas kho rang gi sha la zo zhig khrag la 'thungs shig /dbugs la rngubs shig /srog la choms shig /rus pa rngubs shig /ces pa rnams bri/ mthar mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi rtse phyi la gtad pa bris la/ rgyab tu rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar gling bzhi ri rab lcog brgyad mtshams bzhir mchod rten phyogs bzhi'i phyir rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bkod/ 'di gnyis bltab pa'i tshe 'khor lo'i zur gyi rdo rje phyed pa bzhi byad ma'i steng du 'bebs/ logs kyi rgya gram re la zur re'o// de yang sngar bzhin blta ba/ yang mchod rten sngar bzhin no// zhi rgyas bsrung dang dbang rnams la// yig mgo phyir bstan mngon spyod la// de las bzlog ste shes par bya// 'phrul 'khor gyi bca' gzhi'o/ rlung 'khor du bskor na/ mo 'khor rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can/ pho 'khor rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can la/ dang por/ tad+ya thā/ ga te ga te/ pā ra ga te/ pā ra saṃ ga te/ bo dhi swā hā/ lte bar/ oṃ praṃ swā hā/ pho 'khor/ badz+ra badz+ra ṇi/ rat+na badz+ra ṇi/ pad+ma badz+ra ṇi/ karma badz+ra ṇi/ lte bar/ badz+ra dhā+-ig /gnyis ka'i phyi mthar ye dharmā bkod/ sngar bshad 'khor lo thams cad kyi// lte ba'i yi ge bug pa'i phyir// mu khyud dag la dgod par bya// mo 'khor gnam ltar yig mgo nang*// pho 'khor phyir bstan bu 'khor bar// gnam sa'i dbang gis de bzhin bsgyur// bu 'khor zhi sogs de dag ste// rang rang las bstun rdzas bsgrub dang*// 'dzugs pa'i dus kyang shes par bya// thal rdugs lhag chad skyon rnams spang*// zhi la 'o can rtse mo zlum// bum pa bzang po'i dbyibs su bya// rgyas la gser can rin chen 'bar// dbang la khrag can lcags kyu dang*// drag po tshar shing mtshon gyi rtse// steng 'og rton yang de bzhin sbyar// zhi rgyas dbang gsum g.yas su dang*// drag po thams cad g.yon du yin// ma grub bzlog ste bskor bar bshad// drag po mthu ru bskor ba'i tshe// rang la mi bzlog gnad gsum ste// rang thag dmigs nas yar mar byung*// dgra yul zhing dang khang khyim sa// rkang rjes sa dang zag pa'i rdzas// 'khor lo dag la brten par bya// 'khor lo rang gi brla g.yas la// lag gnyis phyir bskor rnam 'joms kyi// gzungs sngags 'don dang mtshan brjod 'don// 'dzugs dus lha 'dre thams cad la// gzu dpang gser skyems bcol gtad bya// rlung khang zlum po 'ba' zhig nang*// rang las mthun pa'i rdzas dkyil 'khor// sgo bzhir 'byung bzhi'i sa bon bkod// las dang mthun pa'i phyag rgyas mtshan// rab tu gnas byas legs par 'dzugs// 'phrul 'khor gyi cho ga las/

las rlung la 'chol ba rdzogs so/// /de la zhi ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyi rgyu ni// dar ram ras dkar po dri ma med pa'am/ rgya shog dkar gtsang la bsgrubs pa'i 'o ma dang tsan dan gyi khu bas bris/ dus snga dro/ mdog dkar po/ dbyibs zlum po ste pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'o// byug pa'i rdzas kyang bum sman du bshad pa bzhin te/ rdzas de dag dang byin rlabs kyi rten rnyed tshad dang lhan cig tu dngul gyi ga'u zlum po'i nang du gzhug cing rlung 'khor la ni byugs pa nyid kyis chog cing*/ ring bsrel la sogs pa srog shing la'o// rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi rgyu ni/ shing shun nam/ dar shog ser po la bsgrub pa'i gi wang dang gur kum gyis bris/ dus nya'am nyi phyed gong du/ mdog ser po/ dbyibs gru bzhi/ rdzas bum sman du bshad pa bzhin gyis byug /bkra shis pa'i sa sna rdo sna chu sna shing sna/ byin rlabs kyi rten/ 'bru sna rin po che rnyed tshad dang lhan cig gser ram ra gan gyi ga'u gru bzhir gzhug /dbang gi rgyu ni/ shing shun nam/ smad 'tshong ma'i khrag gis sbags pa'i ras sam/ gro ga dmar po la/ mtshal dang li khri/ smad 'tshong ma'i mngal khrag dang*/ smyo byed kyi khu ba bsres pa bsgrubs pas bri'o/ dus phyi dro/ mdog dmar po// dbyibs zla gam mo/ byug pa'i rdzas kyang de nyid de/ tsan dan dmar po'am zangs kyi ga'u zla gam du gzhug cing*/ sman/ khrom dang dge 'dun tshogs dus kyi sa rde'u dang 'bru/ rin po che me tog dmar po'i rigs dang lhan cig tu'o// mngon spyod kyi rgyu ni/ bgegs las bshus pa'i ras sam/ zhing chen gyi pags pa la dug khrag bsgrubs pa ro sol dang bcas pas bri/ dus ni dgra la byed na mtshan phyed/ bgegs la nyin byed/ kha dog nag po/ dbyibs gru gsum/ byug rdzas/ dgra bo'i zag rdzas/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ las dang mthun pa'i thod pa la sogs par gzhug go /bsrung ba la zhi ba'i rdzas kyis byug

/rak+sha gdong gcig pa rma med pa dang*/ rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam rma med pa dang bcas te gri lcags kyi ga'u gru gsum du bcug nas bcang ngo*// bdug pa/ zhi ba lce sgog dkar po/ rgyas pa la gi wang ga bur/ dbang la thal chen gur kum/ drag po la gu gul nag po sogs so// gdab pa'i phur pa yang las mthun gyi shing la rang dbyibs so// rab gnas ni 'khor lo rnams/ laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ baṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yaṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e shud+dhe shud+dhe/ zhes 'byung ba lnga'i khrus byas/ zhi rgyas dbang*/ bsrung bzlog rnams mchod rten gyi bum pa'i phyogs sam/ med na dkyil 'khor gyi steng gang rung du dgod do// bdag lha bskyed pa nas bzlas pa'i bar byas/ 'khor lo bsangs sbyangs/ lha tshogs su bskyed pa nas/ mdun bskyed bskul ba'i bzlas pa'i bar/ bzla dus las dang rjes su mthun pa'i pho nya spro ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dngos grub gang bsgrub pa'i spro bsdu byas/ bzlas sngags gzungs ring gi mthar las kyi sham bu btags pa bzla/ 'khor lo bkrag dang drod 'bar ba dang*/ du bar 'thul ba dang*/ skad 'don pa'i bar du bsgrub bo// de nas mchod bstod byas 'od du zhu ba las/ 'khor lo brten pa'i las tshogs phra mo bshad par bya ste/ pha rol gyi dmag dpung las rgyal bar 'dod na/ lha chen po la phul ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi ras la dug khrag dang dur khrod kyi sol bas las thams cad pa'i 'khor lo lte ba dang 'dod gsol bzhag /gzhan ji lta bar bris la lte bar/ che ge mo'i dmag dpung staṃ bha ya nan zhes pa'i bskul tshig dang 'dod gsol bya/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas spros ba'i pho nyas pha rol gyi dmag dpung stongs grogs kyi lha dang bcas pa bkug cing 'khor lo'i lte bar bstim pa la dmigs nas gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces bzlas pa rdzogs mtshan ma rnyed pa dang lce sgog dkar pos 'dug

/phur pa btab ste thun gyis brab/ mi rus kyi phye mas byugs/ gdug pa'i sa las byas pa'i 'bi 'bi'i nang du bcug /mchod nas spyi tshugs su thod pa kha sbyar du bcug /de dbang chen dang ri bo la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rgyas btab nas gang du g.yul 'gyed pa'i gnas der sbas pas gzhan gyi g.yul pham par 'gyur ro/ pha rol dang rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'dod na/ lte ba dang 'dod gsol ba che ge mo'i ngag staṃ bha ya/ zhes bri/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis pha rol gyi ngag thams cad bkug cing 'khor lo lte bar bstim pa dang*/ grog mkhar gyi sa la gzugs brnyan byas pa'i snying gar bcug nas de la'ang bsgrub bya'i rnam par shes pa la bcug ste/ de nas sngags dang bcas pa'i seng ldeng gi tsher ma dug gi chu la sngags pa lce la bsnun pa dang*/ mthar thod pa kha sbyar du bcug nas rig sngags mnan pa'i sbyor ba byas na pha rol dang rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi las thams cad gcod par 'dod na/ che ge mo'i rig sngags ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da zhes sbyar zhing*/ pho nya'i tshogs kyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i mthu thams cad 'khor lo'i lte bar bsdu ba dang*/ rang gi rig pa'i mthu las byung ba'i mtshon dang me'i tshogs kyis bsregs par dmigs la bzlas shing*/ mthar gu gul gyis bdug /phur pa gdab/ thun gyis brabs nas mi rus kyi phye mas byugs te 'khor lo dum bur gtub/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal ba rlung la bskur bas gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi las thams cad gcod par byed do// bzla ba'i sngags ni gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ de bzhin du/ pha rol gyi rig sngags gnon par 'dod na/ che ge mo'i rig sngags staṃ bha ya nan/ zhes nas/ g.yul bzlog pa'i 'khor lo bzhin du sbyar nas mnan par bya'o// gzhan gyi las thams cad 'joms par 'dod na/

lte bar 'gran sems can gyi ming gang yin bris la/ che ge mo 'di'i las thams cad 'jig par gyur cig /bdug brabs phur bus btab/ ro sol bas byugs/ tsher ma can gyi shing blangs te sbyin sreg byas/ thal ba rlung chen po la phyar na 'grub cing*/ sngags/ ghur+ṇā ghur+ṇā/ ghur+ṇā pa ya ghur+ṇā pa ya dang sbyar ro// sems can thams cad skrag par byed 'dod pas/ gang 'dod pa'i gzugs dang ming*/ 'di skrag par mdzod cig ces/ trā sa ya trā sa ya dang sbyar ba'i sngags bzla zhing spro bsdu byas la/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad du gu gul nag po'i dud pas bdug cing phur pa snying gar btab ste brabs nas yul rlung chen po'i sas byugs nas ri bo drung chen po la phyar na gang la bya ba de kho na skrag par 'gyur ro// 'byung po'i gdon skrag par 'dod na/ tshar gcod pa'i 'byung po'i ming bris nas/ grog mkhar gyis las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar bcug /spro bsdu byas/ sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis brabs pa'i mthar/ dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ gu gul dang*/ byi la'i ril ma dang*/ khyi'i rtug pa sbyar ba'i bdug pas bdugs na rnam par skrag cing tshar gcod par byed do/ sngags ni/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ gzhan gyi lha la sogs pa'i gdon rlag par byed 'dod pa/ gang dag brlag par bya ba'i gdon gyi ming spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas/ grog mkhar dang*/ tsha sgo can dang*/ 'jug ngogs dang*/ shing rkang gcig gi sa dang*/ dur khrod kyi thal ba dang lhan cig sbrus pa las gzugs brnyan byas pa'i snying gar bcug ste/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs nas/ rnam par spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkug cing bcug ste/ 'tshe zhing dum bur gtubs pa dang*/ sreg cing bral bar byed pa la dmigs nas sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis brabs pa'i mthar/

sbyin sreg byas te/ thal ba rlung la phyar na gang la dmigs pa'i gdon de rlag par byed pa la the tshom med do/ sngags ni snga ma nyid do// gdon gang las thar bar 'dod pa'i ming dang spel tshig bris te/ las thams cad gong ma dang 'dra ba las phur pa dang bcas pa la chas gril ba la/ gser dang*/ g.yu rgod dang*/ rdo rgod che ba g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa lus sam mgul du btags na gdon la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro// rengs pa'i las bsgrub par 'dod na/ dur khrod kyi ras la yung ba'i khu bas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo che ge mo kā ya wāka tsi t+ta staṃ bha ya laṃ zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la/ grog mkhar la sogs pa'i sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi khar bcug ste/ brabs pa'i bar spyir mthun pa las thal chen gyis byugs te ma 'khyogs pa rengs pa'i shing la me spar te/ me tog ker btsugs dang*/ rlung gi sha mo dang*/ ril ma la sbyin sreg byas nas thal ba de byi ba'i rlid bur blug ste yungs kar dang yungs nag tu sbyar ba des gar gtor ba de rengs par byed do// sdags ni gha ṭa dang sbyar ro// gzhan yang rmugs par byed 'dod pas/ dur khrod kyi ras la myos byed kyi khu ba dang nim pa'i 'dab mas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar che ge mo mo ha ya zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas/ grog mkhar sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar bcug /brab pa'i bar du byas nas la chas gril rkang 'og tu bcug na nges par rmugs par 'gyur ro// sngags ni saṃ gha ṭa dang sbyar ro// ma grub pa grub par byed pa ni/ bh+ra ma dang sbyar te gang grub par 'dod pa'i ri mo bris la/ cho ga gong ma nyid dang mthun no// yang na ming mgul khug tu gzhug go /grub pa chud mi za bar byed pa ni/ saṃ bha ma dang sbyar te/ gang mngon du gyur pa'i nor rdzas kyi ming bris te/ dal chen po'i dbus su bzhag la bdug pa dang gdab pa dang brab pa rdzogs pa dang ashwa ta'am tsan dan gyi khu bas byugs nas za ma tog tu bcug nas ras gtsang mas dkris nas phur pa dang bcas te rgyas btab la/

sku gzugs sam mchod rten gyis mnan te/ shin tu dben pa'i sar bzhag na nges par chud mi za'o// tshogs bdag la sogs pa'i 'byung po dgug par 'dod na/ smad 'tshong gyi ras la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar bhū tā kar+sha dzaḥzhes pa'i spel ba dang bcas pa bris nas/ grog mkhar la sogs pa'i sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar bcug ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bram ze 'am sngags pa'i thod par bzhag la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs te/ de las spros pa'i pho nyas bkug cing gzhug pa'ang byas te/ sngags kyi mthar 'byung po ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa bzla zhing*/ 'bras chan dang 'bru thug pa dang la phug la sogs pa 'byung po gtor ma'i nye bar sbyar ba byas na 'byung ngo*// zhugs nas bdag gis las ci bya zer ba 'byung ste/ 'byung po dgug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug par sngags pa ni/ sngar bstan pa'i gtor ma dus gsum du sbyin zhing*/ bhū tā wa shaṃ ma nā ya zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags bzlas te/ bram ze mo'i sngags skyes ma gtsang ma'i zla mtshan gyis bgos pa'i ras dang sa rdza ra'i bdug pa byin nas/ mngon par bsngags pa'i tsan dan dmar po'i thig le dpral bar byas na ci bsgo ba nyan cing mngag gzhug gi las byed par 'gyur ro// de ltar dbang du gyur pa de rig sngags kyi las gang bsngags kyang myur du 'grub pa'i grogs byed do// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyi cho ga rgya gzhung rnams las rnyed pa bzhin/ yul dbus grwa dar lung gi ri khrod du pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
